title: See what every choice really costs
text: Learn why spending on one thing means giving up another, so you can explain your choices clearly to anyone.

title: Measure health in a way everyone understands
text: Understand the quality-adjusted life year, a single measure that combines how long and how well people live.

title: Find out what you get for your money
text: Compare the extra cost of a treatment with the extra health it brings, so you can tell good value from expensive hope.

title: Tell real savings from wishful ones
text: Check whether time saved turns into money you can actually spend elsewhere, before you promise a saving.

title: See whether you can afford it
text: Work out what a new service will do to your budget over the next few years, separately from whether it is good value.

title: Know how much to trust your numbers
text: Find which assumptions matter most, so you can show how confident you are and where to look harder.
